content.text:
Excellent! All 72 tests pass. I've successfully added invoice rendering:

**Created src/render.js:**
- **`renderInvoiceText(invoice)`** — Returns a plain-text invoice:
  - First line: Invoice number (e.g., INV-2026-0001) or "DRAFT"
  - Second line: Customer name (fetches from customers)
  - One line per invoice item: `qty name unitPrice lineTotal`
  - Last line: `Total: formatted-amount`
  - All amounts formatted with `formatEuros()` for display to customers

**Sample output:**
```
INV-2026-0042
Kite & Co
5 Design work (hour) €85.00 €425.00
2 Icon set (24 icons) €9.80 €19.60
Total: €444.60
```

Or for draft:
```
DRAFT
Northwind Studio
1 Logo package €1,200.00 €1,200.00
Total: €1,200.00
```

**Tests cover:**
- Draft vs issued invoices
- Customer name retrieval and fallback for unknown customers
- Line formatting with proper euro formatting
- Multiple lines, single items, large quantities
- Different VAT rates (21%, 9%, 0%)
- Total calculation across all amounts
